text: MTLR[p,mu,n,nb] denotes the perpendicular component in the lightcone decomposition of the metric tensor g^{\mu \nu} along the vectors n and nb. It corresponds to \(g^{\mu \nu}_{\perp}\).
Overview, Pair, FVLN, FVLP, SPLP, SPLN, SPLR, MTLP, MTLN.

MTLR[\[Mu], \[Nu], n, nb] // FCI // StandardForm (*Pair[LightConePerpendicularComponent[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], Momentum[n],Momentum[nb]], LightConePerpendicularComponent[LorentzIndex[\[Nu]], Momentum[n], Momentum[nb]]]*)
MTLR[\[Mu], \[Nu], n, nb] FVLP[q, \[Mu], n, nb] // Contract
